title: ヲタク最高すぎるんだが？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back from a day out, Agnes Digital and I take a stroll around a park.

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Um… Excuse me… Digital…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! I know you! I see you all the time at Umamusume fan events! Did you come to make plans for the next one?

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Um… Actually, the truth is… I've been thinking of… giving up on this life.
choice_data_list: Don't be rash! You've got so much ahead of you!
Don't be rash! You've got so much ahead of you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's not what she means. She's talking about the simp life! Still… why would you ever want to?

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: There's this school I want to get into, but it's really competitive. So… I think I have to quit simping in order to focus on my studies.

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: So… I'd like to entrust all the merch I've acquired to you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp. To me?

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Well… I just know that you'll take good care of it all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …I see. Understood. I'll take the merch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: However! And I mean this! I'll take the merch off your hands, but it'll only be for a while.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's right! You're not quitting the life! You're taking time off, is all. Once your studies calm down, I'll be awaiting your proud return!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: B-but… I'm not confident I'll ever be able to come back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You will. I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Do you remember the time during that cold snap we both froze our butts off in the standby line for that merch store?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: The line for merch is over here. Estimated waiting time is about one hour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh, whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oooh… I should've dressed warmer before coming… Brrr!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Oh… Um… I have a heat pad with me, so… we can take turns, if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?! It's my own fault I didn't come here prepared…

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: But, we're in this together, aren't we?! We both came here to support our oshis. We'll make it inside together, come hell or high water!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whooagh! I'm so grateful and happy! Let's show Mother Nature she won't get the best of us!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: …That's right. Supporting my oshi gave me purpose… which is why…

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. It might take me a long, long time, but… I'll definitely be back! In all my simp glory!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Take your time. Remember, us simps are built strong! We can wait on our knees for hours even for mere scraps of new deets about our oshis!
choice_data_list: Is this another side to loving Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No kidding! Sometimes we're competing with each other for event tickets, and other times we're helping each other support our oshis!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: And sometimes we trade merch when we end up with duplicates… Interacting with other fans is one of the many joys to being part of a fandom!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Oh man… I miss it already! Waiting this out is going to be like living life on super hard mode!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: In that case, whenever you need a break from studying, why not dip your toes back in?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Just hold yourself back a bit and you'll be fine. What matters most is showing your fave your love.

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: W-well, I… I'm going to dedicate myself to my studies now, but I'll spare some time to keep supporting my oshis!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And I'll keep an eye on you when you do to make sure it doesn't interfere with your studies. …Welcome back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two exchange a firm handshake, marking this astonishingly quick end to the girl's break from fandom!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh… it wasn't that big a deal. I was just lending a hand to a comrade. For our precious Umas, there is still love to offer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What we give doesn't compare to all the delight they provide for us!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Digital! I knew you were the perfect person to hold onto my collection.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …By the way, you wouldn't happen to have a copy of that ultra rare, raffle-only concert DVD in here, would you?

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Aha, you have a refined taste! Of course it's in there. Nyehehe, enjoy it to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You've just made my day! I promise I'll watch it twice every day—once for both of us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital displays her firm resolve by vowing to revere the Umamusume merch for herself and her fellow fan.
